welcome_message: bricksentry: check what every pipeline run did to your tables, alert on Slack, and get the RESTORE to undo it.

project_name.description: Name for this bundle (letters, digits, underscores)
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use letters, digits and underscores only.

tables.description: Tables to watch, comma-separated catalog.schema.table names (up to 10)
tables.pattern_match_failure_message: Enter 1 to 10 full names like main.sales.orders, separated by commas.

keys.description: Key columns for tables without a PRIMARY KEY: table=col1,col2 separated by ';' (e.g. main.sales.orders=order_id). Leave empty to use each table's PRIMARY KEY
keys.pattern_match_failure_message: Use catalog.schema.table=col1,col2; separate tables with ';'. Or leave empty.

warehouse_id.description: SQL warehouse ID (SQL Warehouses -> your warehouse -> Connection details)
warehouse_id.pattern_match_failure_message: Paste the warehouse ID only, e.g. 1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b.

scratch_schema.description: catalog.schema for the temporary shallow clones (created if missing; clones are dropped after each check)

demo.description: Add a demo job that makes a known-bad change to a demo table in the scratch schema, so your first run shows a block (recommended)

slack_secret.description: Optional: Slack webhook secret as scope/key (e.g. bricksentry/slack_webhook). Leave empty now and add it later

fail_on.description: Mark the run failed when the verdict is at least

bricksentry_version.description: bricksentry version to install in the job (pinned; change it and redeploy to upgrade)

success_message:
Created {{.project_name}}. Next:
  cd {{.project_name}}
  databricks bundle deploy
{{if eq .demo "yes"}}  databricks bundle run bricksentry_demo   # about 2 minutes; ends red with BLOCK, which is the point
{{end}}Then any change to the watched tables is checked automatically. See {{.project_name}}/README.md.
